admission.justification: Weighed explicit listed-unknown wording against hiding or zero-counting outcomes and constrains TaskSummary.consolidation and dashboard unread-memory rendering.

alternatives.option: Render '{total} listed · outcomes not known yet' in the header, 'listed' badges on rows, and an amber unread-memory notice.
alternatives.reason: Shows the authored pass scope truthfully while distinguishing unknown outcomes from zeroed outcome counts.

alternatives.option: Hide the Consolidation block or show zeroed outcome counts when memoryRead is false.
alternatives.reason: Hiding the block conceals the leaf's authored consolidationList, and rendering zero counts falsely implies memory was read and every outcome is zero.
alternatives.reconsider_when: Reconsider if dashboard task-page projection guarantees synchronous memory readability for every consolidation leaf state.

consequences: consolidationBlock.tsx renders the listed-only summary and badges whenever memoryRead is false.
context: When the dashboard projects a consolidation leaf whose memory tree cannot yet be read (memoryRead is false), the Consolidation block still has the task document's consolidationList IDs but no verified per-subject outcomes.

evidence: dashboard vitest (skeleton-bounds.test.tsx, DocumentChat.test.tsx, RoleLauncher.standalone.test.tsx, contract.test.ts), npm run codegen/lint/typecheck, and Evidence 9 pictures.
